acquisition: Original fictional authored records; no web acquisition or real accounts
robots: not applicable to locally authored source
terms: no third-party service used to acquire data
redistribution: Original material offered under CC BY-SA 4.0; implementation separately Apache-2.0
parsing: UTF-8 JSON, preserve raw text and ordered records
normalization: None for Mini GPT; KA search-key-v1 only for lexical indexing, raw bodies retained
filtering: Original baseline unchanged; separate part-v pipeline exercise retains both failing and revised rules
deduplication: Baseline templates intentionally retained; exact identity scan cannot rule out semantic overlap
pii: Fictional orders and policy text; synthetic contact exercise separately uses example.invalid; no real PII claimed
mixture: Mini GPT 22 English + 2 Chinese training records, sampled equally by record; this is not a balanced token mixture
splits: 24 train / 8 validation, whole records before tokenization; related templates, no independent product test
contamination: Public teaching examples and related templates; report overlap and retain old versions, do not claim held-out generalization
updates: New processing rules/data require a separate version; v2 is expanded documentation of unchanged source bytes
limitations: Tiny synthetic corpus; not evidence of population language quality, legal clearance for other data, or safety of a live system
